description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source project. It handles web page logic for managing code tracker configurations, including initializing page arguments, rendering user interfaces, and managing rights.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the user interface, either by displaying a template or redirecting based on the action.

methods.name: initScript
methods.description: Initializes the page, including the command manager, args, and GUI object.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Processes and sanitizes input request parameters, applying whitelist validation.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI-related data, including user privileges and linked test projects.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to access code tracker management functionalities.
